The '''Kashyyyk treeworm''', taking its name from the [[Tree/Legends|forested]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]], was a creature that produced exceptionally durable [[Silk/Legends|silk]]. [[Kashyyyk treeworm silk|This material]] could be found near the planet of [[Bespin/Legends|Bespin]] and its tensile strength had no equal in that region as of<ref name="Card" /> [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]].<ref>''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' places the events of {{Film|V}}, which this ''Customizable Card Game'' expansion set parallels, in this [[Standard year/Legends|year]].</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Kashyyyk treeworm was mentioned in the flavor text of a card from the [[Star Wars Customizable Card Game]]'s ''[[Cloud City Limited]]'' expansion set, released in [[1997]].<ref name="Card" />
